editorial.blurb: Thai Pastry Restaurant delivers generous portions of authentic Thai flavors with impressive care—whether you're dining in or taking it home, the food arrives piping hot and bursting with perfectly balanced seasoning.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the dumplings (they're exceptional and don't need sauce) and ask for spice level adjustments if you prefer milder flavors; the kitchen is happy to accommodate. For dessert, try the mango mousse pie or Thai coffee tiramisu when available.
